label: ngsRelate — pairwise relatedness from genotype likelihoods
description: Pairwise relatedness coefficients (theta, IBS0/1/2, KING) from a BEAGLE genotype-likelihood file restricted to a sites file. Per-pair scores for all N×(N-1)/2 sample pairs.
intended_use: kinship QC, family detection, pedigree input

label: ngsPedigree — pedigree reconstruction from a relatedness matrix
description: Builds the most-likely pedigree (trios / sib groups) from a pairwise-relatedness matrix produced by ngsRelate.
intended_use: trio / family discovery from a kinship matrix; required upstream for Mendelian QC

label: Mendelian inheritance — per-trio error rate
description: Per-trio Mendelian-error rate along the genome. Inputs: pedigree (trios) + BEAGLE genotype likelihoods + sites file. Score is per-trio per-interval.
intended_use: trio QC, sites filtering, sequencing-error model

label: Population statistics — windowed FST / dxy / piN / piS (composite)
description: Window-wise population-genetic statistics between groups defined on a sample set. Wraps region_popstats's groupwise mode; emits a composite popstats_result that downstream readers split into per-metric layers. Decomposed forms (fst_pairwise / dxy / theta_pi) are tracked separately for explicit single-metric requests.
intended_use: manuscript path B: FST scans, divergence between karyotype groups, nucleotide-diversity windows

label: Pairwise FST in windows
description: Window-wise pairwise FST between TWO sample sets along a coordinate scope. Decomposed slice of popstats; explicit when a request asks for FST only.
intended_use: scan a candidate / cohort for population differentiation

label: Nucleotide diversity θπ in windows
description: Window-wise π over one sample set on a coordinate scope. Decomposed slice of popstats (single-group mode).
intended_use: diversity scans inside a candidate or across the genome

label: Between-group divergence dxy in windows
description: Window-wise absolute divergence dxy between TWO sample sets. Decomposed slice of popstats (groupwise mode).
intended_use: divergence between karyotype / population groups along the genome

label: Inversion candidate promoter
description: Promotes window-band signals into candidate intervals with chain evidence.

label: Karyotype auto caller
description: Calls per-sample karyotype 0/1/2 for each candidate.

label: Karyotype polarizer
description: Polarises unpolarized_karyotype_calls against a reference.

label: Inversion pair incompatibility test
description: Scores observed-vs-expected joint karyotype counts for a pair of inversions on different chromosomes (manuscript LG01 x LG28 target). Emits a 3x3 distortion_summary with chi-square per cell.

label: Cross-species breakpoint detection
description: Comparative breakpoint catalog across 18 catfish species + hybrid subgenomes. Two independent method families: gene_order (BUSCO ortholog walk) and sequence (wfmash + STEP_CS01 + BP_ATLAS). Folded via cluster_breakpoints.py with a cross_method flag. BP3c adds BOTH-anchor reciprocity. Headline: LG27 bounded inversion (12.43 + 16.50 Mb), LG23 @ 4.04 Mb cross-method validated.
intended_use: comparative breakpoint catalog; hands coordinates to inversion_atlas; never claims about hatchery samples

label: wfmash pairwise whole-genome alignment
description: Whole-genome pairwise alignment with wfmash (approx-mapping). Divergence-tiered identity threshold (p90 Clarias / p85 Cranoglanis / p80 mid / skip deep). Produces PAFs for downstream breakpoint detection.

label: BUSCO single-copy ortholog table extraction
description: Builds the wide BUSCO single-copy ortholog table across a set of genomes (e.g. synteny18, synteny5). Substrate for gene-order family breakpoint walks across the full catfish phylogeny.
intended_use: input ortholog table for the gene-order family breakpoint walk

label: ngsTracts CO/NCO/DCO/MOSAIC classifier
description: Adapter pair: import_tract_classifications + normalize_tract_classifications. STEP_TRC_01 output.

label: per-(chrom × dyad) CO/DCO/NCO counts
description: Karyotype-stratified rows (homA/het/homB) drive the intrachromosomal-effect view.

label: per-(chrom × interval_a × interval_b) c-coincidence
description: C = r_ab / (r_a · r_b). Derives c when producer omits it; flags c > neg_interference_threshold.

label: per-(tested chrom × local inversion) covariate matrix
description: Filtered subset of inversion_candidates.v1; covariate for interchromosomal page.

label: per-(focal_inv × parent) null-model assignment
description: permutation_block (typically family_id); n_singleton_blocks diagnostic.

label: per-candidate sex-specific CO ideogram + telomere curve
description: Per-inversion-candidate JSON; cross-atlas consumer = genome-atlas page3 CO-density sub-track.

label: per-candidate NCO/GC tract ideogram + telomere curve
description: Sister track to crossover_track; ngsTracts STEP_TRC_01 output keyed per candidate.

label: PRDM9 PWM from CO ±2kb hotspots
description: Optional. MEME / STREME wrapper. Page hides logo card when pwm null.

label: NCO enrichment inside vs outside inversion candidate
description: CHAIN: tract_classifications_v1 → inversion_candidates.v1 → in/out crosstab → Fisher/χ².

label: CO_rate(het) vs CO_rate(non-het) per focal inversion × tested chrom
description: CHAIN: chromosome_meiosis_events_v1 (karyo-stratified) → karyo-strat CO_rate cells <0.7 flag.

label: HEADLINE: focal inversion karyotype → meiosis on OTHER chromosomes
description: CHAIN: coincidence_matrix_v1 + local_inv_controls_v1 + family_aware_permutation_design_v1 → Welch's t (het vs non-het) + family-aware permutation null + BH + Bonferroni across off-focal chroms.

label: tajimas_d
description: Tajima's D per sliding window from BEAGLE GLs.

label: theta_w
description: Watterson's theta per sliding window from BEAGLE GLs.

label: hp
description: Pooled heterozygosity (Hp) per sliding window.

label: da
description: Net divergence dA = dXY - mean(piA, piB) per sliding window between two sample sets.

label: fhom
description: Individual-level F_HOM (excess homozygosity, PLINK --het analog) from BEAGLE GLs. Scope (genome/chrom/interval) is a runtime parameter on the same engine call.

label: fdm
description: Patterson's D + Malinsky 2015 fdM per sliding window with block jackknife. Four-population test for introgression.

label: ihs
description: Voight 2006 iHS (single-cohort), diploid-IBS approximation from unphased BEAGLE GLs. Allele 0 assumed ancestral.

label: xpehh
description: XP-EHH between two cohorts (test vs ref), diploid-IBS approximation from unphased BEAGLE GLs.

label: pi_ns
description: Population pi_N / pi_S per CDS locus with coverage correction + bootstrap CI.

label: pi_0fold_4fold
description: Population pi at 0-fold (purifying) and 4-fold (neutral) degenerate sites per CDS locus + pi_0/pi_4 ratio.

label: dn_ds
description: Pairwise dN/dS (NG86 + YN00 with kappa correction) and 4D-site identity per aligned CDS pair.

label: hobs_per_group
description: Observed and expected heterozygosity per sliding window stratified by group (e.g. karyotype arrangement homA/het/homB).

label: rare_sfs_pairwise
description: Rare-allele site-frequency-spectrum sharing matrix between every pair of sample sets.

label: outlier_scan
description: Statistic-agnostic genome-wide outlier + HDR scan over any per-window TSV stat. --direction high|low|abs. Background normalization + region merging.

label: candidate_vs_flanks
description: Inversion-candidate-support test: Wilcoxon inside vs N-bp flanks for any per-window stat column. Validates that a candidate is genuinely different from local background.

label: q_residual_dosage
description: Per-sample residual genotype dosage after regressing out global Q. Input to karyotype clustering and inversion candidate calling.

label: snp_q_support
description: Per-SNP soft Q-support classifier. Pearson |corr| of dosage vs each Q column -> normalized soft weights -> classifies SNPs (dominant_single_Q / dominant_plus_secondary / mixed / diffuse / low_info). Aggregates to per-window coherence + switch count + dominant Q.

label: internal_ancestry_composition
description: Generic interval-internal ancestry classifier. For each parent interval (chrom, MDS candidate, inversion candidate), characterizes internal Q composition per sample: dominant-label blocks, switches, internal entropy, fragmentation. Classifies homogeneous / dominant_plus_secondary / two_block_composite / continuous_gradient / multi_block_fragmented / diffuse_mixed.

label: inversion_candidate_classifier
description: Inversion-candidate classifier. Overlays Q-support windows + per-sample Q + internal composition onto each candidate. Emits coherent_q_loaded_core / likely_mixed_background / likely_parasite_windows / ancestry_class (ancestry_driven vs structural vs mixed). The structural-vs-ancestry-driven verdict drives downstream path selection (path A ancestry, path B inversion).

label: hobs_hwe_pipeline
description: Full Hobs/HWE pipeline: build subset bamlists -> ANGSD -doHWE per subset -> hobs_windower per scale. Produces multi-scale per-subset Hobs / Hexp / F / HWE p-value windows.

label: hobs_hwe_candidate_overlay
description: Overlay Hobs/HWE windows on inversion candidates. Per (candidate, subset, scale): mean/median F + Hobs within interval, outlier burden, comparison to flanking regions, distortion pattern classification (homozygous_excess / heterozygote_excess / mixed). Inversion karyotyping signal: Hobs collapse inside inverted region.

label: karyotype_resolution
description: Per-candidate per-sample karyotype assignment (homA / het / homB). Composes q_residual_dosage + hobs_hwe_candidate_overlay -> clustering (k-means or model-based) -> labels with posterior. Distinguishes against background by comparing within-candidate stats to genome-wide null.

label: instant_q_boundary_scan
description: Inversion-boundary detection from per-window local-ancestry Q tracks (instant_q output). Scans for Q-composition shifts across windows + change-point detection -> candidate interval intervals (chrom, start, end). Feeds the candidate classifier and karyotype resolver downstream.

label: inversion_groupwise_popstats
description: Manuscript path B chain: inversion_karyotypes -> partition samples into homA/het/homB -> popstats_groupwise inside the inversion candidate interval. Returns per-arrangement (theta_pi, Hp, FIS) + pairwise (FST, dXY, dA) popstats restricted to the candidate.

label: kinship_theta
description: Jacquard-EM-derived kinship coefficient θ per pair. Source column 'theta' in ngsRelate .res output. Untouched by the fork patch.

label: king_robust_kinship
description: KING-robust kinship per pair. Source column 'KING' in .res output. Drives the per-pair prior class assignment used by the adaptive scheduler.

label: jacquard_coefficients_9
description: Jacquard 9-coefficient vector (J1–J9) per pair. Load-bearing path for ngsPedigree; untouched by the fork patch.

label: ibs_counts
description: IBS0/IBS1/IBS2 site counts per pair. IBS0 ≤ 0.008 splits parent_offspring vs full_sibling inside the KING first-degree band.

label: inbreeding_F
description: Per-sample inbreeding coefficient F via ngsRelate -F. Single-individual mode, not pair-based.

label: relatedness_per_chrom_adaptive
description: CHAIN: KING-class prior derivation from a genome-wide .res anchor → per-pair budgeting by class → per-pair binary calls (ngsRelate-fast -a/-b -D 0) → escalation pass for boundary / interesting-disagreement pairs → canonical-ordered per-chrom .res. Manuscript path for catfish inversion analysis.

label: relatedness_adaptive_validation
description: Six-gate validator (SPEC §6) diffing an adaptive per-chrom .res against a uniform-stride baseline. Tier-1: Gate 4 (PO dyad set equality, FS Jaccard ≥0.99, |Δθ| ≤ 0.05) and Gate 6 (≥95% interesting-recall + zero loss of parent_offspring → unrelated transitions).

label: Import table
description: Read a tabular file (TSV/CSV/JSON) from the workspace and emit a staging_genome_table_v0 layer. Used for assembly metrics, BRAKER summaries, TE-density tracks, synteny block tables — anywhere the producer is an external pipeline and the atlas just needs the result indexed.

label: Cactus pairwise alignment
description: Server-side Cactus + wfmash pairwise alignment, triggered from page_synteny when the user picks a new genome pair. Browser-too-heavy: Cactus needs minutes of CPU + ~GB of RAM per run.

label: WGDI ancestral karyotype reconstruction
description: Server-side WGDI run to reconstruct an ancestral karyotype from a set of synteny blocks. Triggered from page_ancestral_karyotype on user request.

label: macrosyntR-style Oxford-grid reordering
description: Greedy diagonal reordering of chrom labels in the page_synteny V4 Oxford grid. Currently runs in-browser (see page_synteny.js). Promote to server-side if browser CPU becomes the bottleneck on the real ~20k-gene catfish dataset.

label: Per-pair orthologue lookup
description: On click of a page_orthologues V3 cell, fetch the per-pair gene-level rows. Currently a direct file fetch of data/comparative/orthologs/pairs/<a>_<b>.json; would become an atlas-side join if the per-pair tables grow past a fetch-and-render budget.

label: genomewide_heterozygosity
description: Per-sample genome-wide heterozygosity from a folded 1-D SFS: H = sfs_bin1 / (sfs_bin0 + sfs_bin1). Computed by realSFS -fold 1 upstream; extracted from 04_summary/genomewide_heterozygosity.tsv. Atomic stat — one value per sample.

label: sfs_folded_1d
description: Per-sample folded 1-D SFS from realSFS -fold 1. Two-bin output (bin0, bin1). Substrate for genomewide_heterozygosity and any downstream demographic-model inputs.

label: theta_pi_windows
description: Per-sample pairwise nucleotide diversity θπ in windows from ANGSD doThetaStat (pestPG column tP / nSites per window). Scale is a runtime parameter (win_bp / step_bp); the atlas pre-bakes four scales (10kb/2kb, 5kb/1kb, 50kb/10kb, 500kb/500kb) and the planned run_thetastat runner produces arbitrary scales.

label: theta_w_windows
description: Watterson's θ in windows from the same pestPG output (column tW). Independent atomic stat — computed jointly with θπ but reports a different summary of the SFS.

label: tajimas_d_windows
description: Tajima's D in windows from the same pestPG output (column Tajima). Departure of the SFS from neutrality.

label: theta_pi_aggregate_cohort
description: Cross-sample θπ aggregate at a requested window scale. Sums tP and nSites across the per-sample pestPG files and re-derives a cohort θπ track.

label: roh_per_sample
description: Per-sample ROH (runs-of-homozygosity) segment table — chrom, start_bp, end_bp, length_bp, n_sites, quality. PLANNED — pipeline output is empty on disk today. Substrate for every F_ROH-derived metric on the atlas.

label: ancestry_het_kruskal
description: Kruskal-Wallis omnibus test of per-sample heterozygosity across K ancestry-cluster labels. K is a runtime parameter (K∈2..12); cohort is a runtime parameter (cohort∈{all226, pruned81}).

label: ancestry_het_anova
description: ANOVA of per-sample heterozygosity across K ancestry-cluster labels — parametric counterpart to ancestry_het_kruskal. Same runtime parameters.

label: ancestry_het_pairwise_wilcox
description: Pairwise post-hoc Wilcoxon test of per-sample heterozygosity between K ancestry-cluster labels. K and cohort are runtime parameters.

label: ancestry_het_pairwise_ttest
description: Pairwise post-hoc t-test of per-sample heterozygosity between K ancestry-cluster labels. Parametric counterpart to ancestry_het_pairwise_wilcox.

label: ancestry_q_correlations
description: Per-Q-component × per-sample-H Spearman correlation matrix. Tests whether each ancestry component (NGSadmix Q vector) tracks heterozygosity.

label: import_slot
description: Provenance-capture primitive. Wraps GET /api/diversity/{slot} (atlas-core's diversity_endpoint.py) and records the response as a staging_diversity_slot_v0 layer with provenance metadata.

label: per_sample_diversity_assembly
description: CHAIN. Composes genomewide_heterozygosity + sfs_folded_1d + theta_pi_windows + roh_per_sample for ONE sample. Produces a per-sample diversity envelope — the natural unit a hatchery manager wants per fish. Required dimensions: sample_id (plus win_bp/step_bp for the θπ scale). Currently partial — 3 of 4 atomics are live; roh_per_sample is planned.

label: ancestry_het_test_battery
description: CHAIN. Runs the full ancestry × heterozygosity test battery across the K-sweep × cohort grid (K∈2..12, cohort∈{all226, pruned81}). Produces an aggregated test-result envelope spanning kruskal + anova + pairwise_wilcox + pairwise_ttest + q_correlations. The substrate behind page 4 (ancestry).

label: cohort_master_assembly
description: CHAIN. Joins per-sample genomewide_heterozygosity + roh_per_sample + ngsF-HMM convergence + K=8 cluster labels into a single per-sample master table. PLANNED — the canonical D.S1 replacement, blocked on roh_per_sample.

label: haplotype_projection
description: Project parental consequence-annotated variants onto offspring haplotype copies via the Stage 3 inheritance map. Dyad and triad are runtime parameters of the same algorithm; family hubs are NOT a unit of aggregation.

label: offspring_gene_status
description: Per-(offspring, gene, segment) classification across the seven-class enum: reference_like / het_masked / hom_exposed_same_variant / compound_het_trans / compound_het_cis / partially_resolved / unresolved.

label: transmission_summary
description: Per-(dyad or triad) rollup: variant transmission counts, gene-status counts, Mendelian-consistency status, and de-novo candidate flags (triad-only — dyads expose only the parent-hom Mendelian subset).

label: hpp_kbc_arrangement_crosscheck
description: For damaging variants inside inversion intervals, compare HPP per-offspring hap_copy assignment with the KBC karyotype-derived arrangement-background assignment. Discordances flag Stage-3 boundary noise or KBC-edge effects; not a primary result.

label: hpp_offspring_pipeline
description: CHAIN: Stage 2 dyad_or_triad_set → Stage 3 inheritance_map → haplotype_projection → offspring_gene_status. Optional terminal blocs: transmission_summary, hpp_kbc_arrangement_crosscheck. Headline product is the per-offspring gene-status table — the manuscript supplementary deliverable.

label: Pairwise wfmash (two-pass)
description: Per-pair wfmash alignment with Pass A (-s 100k sensitive) + Pass B (-s 500k backbone). Divergence-tiered identity (p90/85/80/skip).

label: Per-PAF breakpoint event extraction
description: Walk PAF blocks per query chromosome; emit NONCOLLINEAR/INVERSION/INTERCHROM/INVERTED_TRANSLOC events with --min-mapq 1.

label: Cluster events into zones per anchor
description: Cluster per-pair breakpoint events across pairs into zones with confidence tiers and backbone_support from Pass B.

label: Both-anchor reciprocity (BP3c)
description: Cross-validate zones from Cgar anchor vs Cmac anchor; emit reciprocity_table.tsv of zones supported from both directions.

label: BP5 atlas data + PAF arcs (figure prep)
description: Prepare atlas_data.json + atlas_paf_arcs.json for the BP5 figure layer (ribbons, dotplots, montage).

label: BP6 joint A-E classification
description: Combine zone + reciprocity evidence into a single A-E classification per breakpoint (manuscript-table ready).

label: Gene-order breakpoint extraction
description: Extract breakpoint edges from macrosyntR wide ortholog tables (18sp + 5sp). Independent method family from wfmash sequence alignment.

label: Tolerance-cluster consolidation + cross-method flag
description: Consolidate breakpoints across methods (gene_order vs wfmash sequence) with tolerance-cluster sweep 500kb -> 1kb. cross_method flag = TRUE only when both method families agree within tolerance.

label: BP_ATLAS chain (sequence method, full)
description: Chain pairwise_wfmash_two_pass -> breakpoint_events -> breakpoint_zones -> breakpoint_reciprocity -> breakpoint_paf_arcs -> breakpoint_joint_classify. Two-pass wfmash + zone clustering + both-anchor reciprocity + figure prep + A-E classification.

label: Gene-order + cross-method chain
description: Chain gene_order_breakpoints -> gene_order_cluster_consolidation. Independent gene-order detection family that consolidates against bp_atlas_pipeline outputs to produce the cross-method-validated headline catalogue.

label: Per-regime Mendelian annotation (trios + families)
description: Cluster 4 of the haplotype-regimes pipeline. Method A (trio contradiction counting) + Method B (per-family chi-sq goodness-of-fit). Per-regime support_status + per-family segregation_status.

label: Inverse pedigree from regime co-membership
description: Cluster 4 of the haplotype-regimes pipeline. Cross-regime same-class fraction across many regimes -> pairwise relatedness verdicts (DUPLICATE / FIRST_DEGREE / SECOND_DEGREE / UNRELATED / INSUFFICIENT_DATA).

label: MSMC2 per founder-like ancestry background
description: SPEC ONLY (specs_todo/SPEC_msmc_per_founder_background.md). Long-range regimes -> sample x sample regime-sharing matrix -> cluster into founder-like backgrounds -> mask inversions/LRR/ROH -> MSMC2 per group -> validate with pi/theta_W/Tajimas_D/LD/FROH/FHOM. Forbids mixed-pool runs + per-chromosome Ne as a headline.

label: Per-window K-means on local PCA
description: Per-window K-means clustering on the per-window PC1 vector. Adaptive K via silhouette (kRange 2-6) or fixed K=3. Foundation of every downstream haplotype-regimes analysis. See docs/PIPELINE_ANALYSIS_ORDER.md Cluster 0.

label: Per-window band-quality scorer
description: silhouette + size-balance + eig-ratio combined to [0,1]. Gates seed-discovery anchor selection (≥ 0.50 by default).

label: Stage 1 V-walker seed discovery
description: Coarse anchor sweep + band_quality refinement + V/H_off walker with hysteresis. Produces the seed catalogue per chromosome. Cluster 1 Path A.

label: Het-skeleton seed detection
description: het_detect_candidate_band per window → het_track_skeleton (Jaccard walk) → het_define_interval → hom_anchor_to_het. Cluster 1 Path B.

label: Cluster 2 voting orchestrator
description: For each focal (seed_id, band_mask): project onto every target window via projection.classifyProjection; aggregate via vote_evidence + band_voters; enumerate partitions; consensus_partition. Produces per-focal consensus + pattern_class matrix. Cluster 2.

label: Within-regime arrangement-identity refinement
description: refineRegimesFromIntervals: given intervals identified by Cluster 2, decide EXTENSION/NESTED/SHARED_HET/SWAPPED/UNRELATED. NOT the long-range detector (that's Cluster 2) — this resolves whether two intervals are the same physical inversion arrangement.

label: Cross-regime topology
description: Per-chromosome cross-regime relationships: NESTED / ADJACENT / CHAINED / OVERLAPPING_CONFLICT / INDEPENDENT. Walks CHAINED edges into multi-inversion lineage chains.

label: Genome-scale regime aggregation
description: mergePerChromosomeRegimes + crossChromosomeRegimeLinks. On-page subset of genome_scale.js (the relatedness exports forward to popstats).

label: Catalogue serializer (cross-page contract)
description: serializeCatalogue emits manifest + knobs + catalogue JSON triple. Content-addressed by knob_hash (SHA-1 prefix). The cross-atlas contract — consumed by evolution + popstats atlases.

label: Haplotype-regimes full pipeline (chain)
description: Full Cluster 1 V-walker → Cluster 2 → Cluster 3 chain. Cluster 1 produces seeds via banding_pipeline.runStage1 (V-walker); Cluster 2 runs banding_pipeline.runStage2/3/4 (cross-seed voting + locus construction + breadth voting); Cluster 3 chains haplotype_regime_refine + regime_topology + genome_scale + regime_catalogue.

label: Haplotype regimes via het-skeleton (chain)
description: Alternative Cluster 1 entry path: het_skeleton_detection (replaces V-walker) → Cluster 2 → Cluster 3. Same downstream as banding_pipeline_full.

label: Per-candidate age estimation (BUSCO 4D)
description: BUSCO 4D-substitution-based age computation. Takes dxy between arrangements; outputs age_my using 3 frozen μ values (low/mid/high) → 3 age brackets.

label: Age-model suggester
description: Suggests which age model (low/mid/high μ) best fits the per-candidate dxy + private-variant pattern. Wraps busco_4d_age.

label: Outgroup synteny polarization
description: Per-outgroup-species break-point orientation vote (HOM_A / HOM_B / unresolved), aggregated to an arrangement verdict. Consumes crossSpecies.synteny_18sp_v1.

label: Stacked MSA polarization (founder + doubleton)
description: Stacked-consensus MSA view: outgroup row + INV founder-like consensus row + per-subgroup consensus rows (from 2D-SFS doubleton hierarchical clustering) + STD consensus row. Confidence + reason tier per site.

label: Sub-PCA on derived-only samples
description: Looks for haplotype clusters / nested rearrangements / sublineages inside the inversion class. Consumes crossSpecies.mgl_pca_compute helpers.

label: Minimum-spanning haplotype network
description: Per-candidate haplotype network of INV chromosomes. Nodes are Hamming-radius clusters; edges are pairwise mutational distance.

label: Recombinant-tract / polarity-switch detector
description: Per-sample per-window mosaic-call + summary leakage score on INV chromosomes.

label: Layer 0/1 noise removal (kinship downweight)
description: Kinship + family-size downweighting + hatchery-duplicate exclusion so close relatives don't double-count in deep-Layer-2 stats.

label: Relative-ordering of inversions on a chromosome
description: Relative-ordering inference across multiple inversions on the same chromosome — carrier-overlap nesting, internal diversity ranking, outgroup presence, age class chaining.

label: Per-candidate archaeology synthesis card
description: Pulls together polarity, age class, integrity, mosaicism, frequency, π/dXY/FST, private/fixed counts, and confidence into one verdict.

label: Copy-origin painting (Stage 5.6, SPEC ONLY)
description: SPEC ONLY per specs_todo/SPEC_copy_origin_painting.md. Awaiting audit before implementation.
